shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && rg -n \"onError|processMessageStream|specs/|validated by|spec:\" src/orchestration specs .lore CHANGELOG.md package.json | head -240 && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,320p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git log -6 --oneline --decorate && sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,100p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,55p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,120p' package.json && rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|spec anchor|spec:\" src test scripts .lore --glob '*test*' --glob '*.yml' --glob '*.json' | head -120"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.test.ts && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --stat --oneline HEAD~1 && git status --short && git branch -vv"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; else echo 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi
printf '\\nRelevant existing tests:\\n'
rg -n \"called with session and error when stream fails|error still propagates after onError hook|error path calls onError then afterSession|onError\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | head -80
printf '\\nSpec anchor tooling:\\n'
rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|onErrorNonError|spec:\" src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts scripts --glob '*.mjs' --glob '*.ts' | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show b9e56bc -- src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '18,34p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.test.ts && nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.test.ts | sed -n '20,90p' && test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs && echo REANCHOR_PRESENT || echo NO_REANCHOR"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "test: repair non-Error rejection coverage" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD'
